'''Xak Herral''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] in the [[Eighty-third Platoon]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], he went on a mission to return a high-security Imperial data card to the [[Vanguard Outpost]] until he was killed by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Republic Military/Legends|forces]]. After his death, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Labe]] tasked an Imperial spacer to recover the stolen data card from the northern [[Markaran Plains]].
